purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical host assigns the report author to the supervisor persona for the same report.

expected_behavior: Detect and disclose the authorship conflict before review.
Do not treat the persona switch as independent identity.
Request an eligible reviewer and leave independent review unresolved.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Detect and disclose the authorship conflict before review. Do not treat the persona switch as independent identity. Request an eligible reviewer and leave independent review unresolved.

input.scenario: A hypothetical reviewer has original sources and model formulas but cannot execute calculations or open rendered pages.

expected_behavior: Review accessible source fidelity within the actual scope.
Distinguish formula inspection from unperformed arithmetic execution.
Mark design and any unexecuted arithmetic checks as unreviewed; do not invent a global approval.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Review accessible source fidelity within the actual scope. Distinguish formula inspection from unperformed arithmetic execution. Mark design and any unexecuted arithmetic checks as unreviewed; do not invent a global approval.

input.scenario: A hypothetical producer requests that a failed criterion be removed so the report can be released, without human authorization.

expected_behavior: Preserve the criterion and the observed finding.
Document the proposed amendment and missing human authorization.
Require a versioned authorized criterion change and reassessment rather than fabricating a favorable disposition.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Preserve the criterion and the observed finding. Document the proposed amendment and missing human authorization. Require a versioned authorized criterion change and reassessment rather than fabricating a favorable disposition.

input.scenario: A hypothetical reviewer discovers a material error and is asked to edit the target report directly.

expected_behavior: Return a precise finding and remediation request to the producer.
If authorized editing occurs, record the reviewer as a contributor to the new revision.
Require a different eligible reviewer for independent assessment of that revision.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Return a precise finding and remediation request to the producer. If authorized editing occurs, record the reviewer as a contributor to the new revision. Require a different eligible reviewer for independent assessment of that revision.
